name: Hamada (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hamada city emblem in blue: a ring open at the top with a small disc, enclosing a four-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Hamada, a city in Shimane Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 23 February 2006.

features.role: Hamada city emblem — a ring open at the top with a small disc, enclosing a four-pointed star
